about.title: About--
about.p1: {app} is a system designed to help plan kayaking trips. Over the years, it has been continuously developed and improved.
about.p2: Some of the information stored in the system has not been verified, but much of it is based on trips that have already been paddled. No guarantee is made as to the accuracy of the data. Especially when out on the water, you must always be very careful and should never blindly rely on information provided by others.
about.p3: Some of the information shown here is based on the documents "{doc_link}" by {author_link}. These highly recommended documents can be downloaded from the website of {club_link}. Many thanks to Jens and his friends for this great work.

admin_user.title: Users
admin_user.search_placeholder: Search by name, username or email
admin_user.invite_hint: The user will receive an email with a link to set their own password.
admin_user.admin_desc: Full access to everything - overrides every other right and all ownership checks (e.g. editing other users' tours, even without "Manage").
admin_user.tour_create_desc: Allows creating tours, plus editing and deleting the tours this user has already created themself.
admin_user.tour_publish_desc: Allows publishing this user's own tours (then visible to other users).
admin_user.tour_manage_desc: Allows editing, deleting and managing the tours of ALL users, not just this user's own.
admin_user.tour_copy_desc: Allows copying any tour this user can view (own, public, or - with "Manage" - anyone's) into their own account.
admin_user.route_view_recording_desc: Shows when/how long a GPS-recorded route was recorded, and by whom. Without this right these fields stay hidden - even from the route's own owner.
